# The Hexagons portable runtime

This folder was generated by the canonical The Hexagons exporter.

- Source repository: `John-Ryan21337/the-hexagons-atmosphere`
- Source commit: `5f0ae96e8a3d5b34bce87edad8225684af7a2d29`
- Export target: `club-code`
- Bundled falling effects: disabled

The canonical schema-14 runtime is integrated with Club Code's stricter Canvas fallback tile,
backing-store, and idle-time budgets. Those host limits remain Club Code-owned policy.

Schema 14 adds compatible grouped-piston modes, tile-grid/piston/six-point-star/combined mesh-energy
routes, and optional directional mesh flow. Schema 10 and older supported presets migrate at the
host boundary; future schema versions remain rejected until Club Code updates its runtime.

Club Code imports only the portable runtime. Club Code owns activation, reduced-motion behavior,
focus and visibility behavior, and its native falling effects.

The bundled `SeaOfLightsInDarkstaticy` preset is the operator-approved Club Code appearance
captured on 2026-08-24. It is the only bundled Hexagons preset. Its activation hints are off.
Club Code does not enable the background on a fresh installation.
